name: Integration for Zoho CRM & Zoho Bigin – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms & More
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
Easily connect Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin with top WordPress form plugins like Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and Formidable Forms.

Automatically send form submissions to Zoho CRM or Bigin modules like Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals, and Custom Modules. No coding required — just authenticate, map fields, and start syncing form data in real time.

Perfect for businesses using WordPress and Zoho for lead management and CRM automation.

Supported Form Plugins:
– Contact Form 7
– WPForms
– Elementor Forms
– Gravity Forms
– Formidable Forms

Benefits:
– Real-time data sync with Zoho CRM and Bigin
– Connect one or both Zoho platforms as needed
– Custom field mapping for advanced control
– Multi-account support
– Error logging and retry for failed entries

Features

One-Click OAuth Authentication
Securely connect your Zoho CRM account with a few simple steps. Supports multiple accounts and easy management.

Custom Field Mapping
Map your form fields to Zoho CRM fields including custom properties for structured and accurate data transfer.

Error Log and Resync
Automatically logs failed submissions with detailed error messages. Retry failed records individually or in bulk.

Multi-Form Integration
Works with the most popular form plugins in a single solution. No need for multiple integrations.

Support

Need help or have a feature request?

  • Contact Support
  • Feature Request

Website: https://integrazo.com/
Email: support@integrazo.com

Additional Notes

This plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite installations. Tested rigorously to ensure reliable and efficient CRM integrations.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
2. In the search bar, type Integrazo and locate this plugin.
3. Click Install and then Activate.
4. Go to plugin settings to connect your Zoho account and start syncing.

Manual Installation
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
2. Activate the plugin.
3. Go to plugin settings and complete the setup.
sections.faq:
Which WordPress forms does this plugin support?

This plugin supports integration of Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin with the following WordPress form plugins:

  • Contact Form 7 – Connect Contact Form 7 with Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin for seamless data syncing and lead capture.
  • WPForms – Integrate WPForms with Zoho CRM and Bigin to automate form data transfer.
  • Elementor Forms – Send Elementor form submissions to Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin in real-time.
  • Gravity Forms – Sync Gravity Forms entries with Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin effortlessly.
  • Formidable Forms – Automate Formidable Forms submission flow to Zoho CRM or Bigin.

Need support for other forms? Submit a request on our Feature Request page.

How to integrate Contact Form 7 with Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin?

To connect Contact Form 7 with either Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin:

  1. Open plugin settings and go to the Setup tab.
  2. Choose Contact Form 7 as the form type.
  3. Select the Zoho product (CRM or Bigin) you want to connect with.
  4. Choose the module (Leads, Contacts, Deals, etc.).
  5. Map form fields to Zoho fields using the provided interface.
  6. Click Save Integration to start syncing form entries.

How to integrate WPForms with Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin?

To integrate WPForms with Zoho CRM or Bigin:

  1. Go to the plugin’s Setup section.
  2. Choose WPForms as your form type.
  3. Select Zoho CRM or Bigin and pick the desired module.
  4. Map WPForms fields to Zoho fields.
  5. Click Save Integration to enable syncing.

How to integrate Elementor Forms with Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin?

To connect Elementor Forms with Zoho:

  1. Go to plugin settings > Setup tab.
  2. Select Elementor Forms from the form list.
  3. Choose Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin and assign a module.
  4. Map Elementor form fields with Zoho fields.
  5. Click Save Integration.

How to integrate Gravity Forms with Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin?

To set up Gravity Forms integration:

  1. Navigate to the Setup section of the plugin.
  2. Choose Gravity Forms.
  3. Pick either Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin as the integration platform.
  4. Select your module and map the fields.
  5. Save the integration to begin syncing.

How to integrate Formidable Forms with Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin?

To connect Formidable Forms with Zoho CRM or Bigin:

  1. Open the plugin’s Setup section.
  2. Choose Formidable Forms.
  3. Select Zoho CRM or Bigin, and the relevant module.
  4. Match form fields to Zoho fields.
  5. Save the integration to activate syncing.

What happens if a form submission fails to reach Zoho CRM or Bigin?

Failed submissions will be:

  • Logged in the Error Logs section
  • Displayed with the error message returned by Zoho
  • Available for resync manually or in bulk

Can I send file attachments from forms to Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin?

Yes, in the premium version:

  • Uploads from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor, and Formidable are supported
  • Files are attached to the corresponding Zoho CRM or Bigin record

Is real-time sync supported for Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin?

Yes, form entries are synced instantly with Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin upon submission.

Does the plugin support conditional logic?

Yes, you can:

  • Define rules for when to send submissions
  • Set up conditions for Zoho CRM and Bigin workflows

How to troubleshoot Zoho CRM or Bigin integration issues?

If you face integration issues:

  • Verify API credentials and re-authenticate
  • Confirm field mappings are valid
  • Check error logs for details
  • Ensure Zoho API limits aren’t exceeded
  • Contact our Support Team

Do I need a Zoho account to use this plugin?

Yes, an active Zoho CRM or Zoho Bigin account is required for integration.

Is the data transfer secure between WordPress and Zoho?

Yes. The plugin uses:

  • OAuth 2.0 secure authentication
  • Encrypted API communication
  • GDPR-compliant data handling
